modelReview.summary: The manuscript suffers from critical reporting errors (mislabeled CIs, omitted coefficient), implausible diagnostic values (BIC = -1032.9), undefined study question, and reliance on an exploratory analysis posture presented as final. These issues block any interpretation or dissemination. A full protocol and re-analysis are necessary.

findings.title: CIs reported on log-odds scale misinterpreted as odds-ratio CIs
findings.whyItMatters: Readers will misinterpret confidence intervals, potentially inferring no significant effect when odds-ratio CI does not cross 1.
findings.actionableFix: Report odds-ratio 95% CIs from stats-run.json (or_ci_low, or_ci_high).
findings.deterministicVerification: Compare manuscript CI values to stats-run.json estimate CI vs or CI.

findings.title: Diagnostic BIC is nonsense (-1032.9) signaling a calculation error
findings.whyItMatters: Undermines trust in all diagnostics; model fit may be unreliable.
findings.actionableFix: Recalculate BIC correctly; check logistic regression implementation.

findings.title: Analysis posture is explicitly exploratory but manuscript frames as final study report
findings.whyItMatters: Misrepresents evidence grade, violating guideline that exploratory analyses should not be promoted as confirmatory.
findings.actionableFix: Either bind to a proper study protocol and re-run as confirmatory, or clearly label as exploratory and downgrade claims.

findings.title: Prespecified study question not stated; the introduction is a generic template
findings.whyItMatters: The research purpose is undefined; no hypothesis to evaluate.
findings.actionableFix: State the specific clinical/public-health question, exposure, outcome, and population of interest.

findings.title: No separation diagnostics, and event count per variable unknown
findings.whyItMatters: With 5 predictors and only 240 obs, separation is possible; Wald p-values and CIs may be inaccurate.
findings.actionableFix: Report number of outcome events; check for separation using likelihood ratio tests, profile CIs, or Firth's correction.

findings.title: Albumin estimate is omitted from manuscript results
findings.whyItMatters: Selective reporting of coefficients could bias interpretation.
findings.actionableFix: Include all model terms in results.

findings.title: Shapiro-Wilk test applied to logistic regression residuals is irrelevant
findings.whyItMatters: May confuse readers and suggests misuse of linear model diagnostics for logistic.
findings.actionableFix: Remove or replace with appropriate diagnostics (e.g., Hosmer-Lemeshow, deviance residuals vs fitted).

findings.title: Limitations contain placeholder text: 'No reader-facing paper/manuscript artifact was found.'
findings.whyItMatters: It is self-referential and confuses readers.

missingEvidence: Separation/convergence diagnostics (profile CIs, likelihood ratio tests)
Cohort construction details: inclusion/exclusion criteria, missingness pattern
